expectations.text: Explains informative references as crosswalks mapping CSF 2.0 outcomes (functions/categories/subcategories) to other standards and resources
expectations.evidence: Informative References (mappings to other frameworks and standards)... query the Reference Tool by CSF subcategory... or by source framework

expectations.text: Points to NIST SP 1347, the CSF 2.0 Informative References Quick-Start Guide, finalized August 2026
expectations.evidence: NIST also published SP 1347 (final, August 25, 2026) as a quick-start guide specifically explaining how these crosswalks work

expectations.text: Mentions the CSF 2.0 Reference Tool for browsing/exporting reference data
expectations.evidence: CSF 2.0 moved them entirely online into the NIST CSF 2.0 Reference Tool... lets NIST... keep mappings current

expectations.text: Mentions the OLIR (Online Informative References) program as the mechanism behind the mappings
expectations.evidence: The mechanism behind this is the Online Informative References (OLIR) Program

expectations.text: Demonstrates a concrete mapping use: e.g., ISO 27001/SP 800-53/CIS Controls mapped against CSF subcategories for gap or evidence reuse
expectations.evidence: Concrete ISO 27001:2022 Annex A to CSF crosswalk table (e.g., PR.AA mapped to A.5.15-5.18, A.8.2-8.5) plus SoA-driven gap process
